dobot-atom-shenzhen-cinema.title: DOBOT Humanoid Operates 14 Hours Daily Selling 1,000+ Popcorn Cups at Shenzhen K11 Cinema
dobot-atom-shenzhen-cinema.summary: Reported by People's Daily, DOBOT's humanoid robot works 14-hour daily shifts as a popcorn attendant at a Shenzhen K11 shopping mall cinema, selling over 1,000 cups per day in continuous commercial retail operation.

leju-kuavo-auto-parts-line.title: 15 Leju Wheeled Humanoids Run Trouble-Free for Over 2 Months on Auto Parts Line
leju-kuavo-auto-parts-line.summary: Per a Securities Daily field report, 15 wheeled humanoid robots from Leju Robotics have operated continuously without failure for over two months on a listed auto-parts supplier's production line, handling bearing recognition, grasping, and feeding.

spot-globalfoundries-singapore-fab.title: Boston Dynamics Spot Logs 900 km & 99% Success at GlobalFoundries Singapore Fab; Atlas Trials Next
spot-globalfoundries-singapore-fab.summary: Two Spot quadrupeds at GlobalFoundries' Singapore fab have logged ~900 km and 90,000+ inspection tasks at a 99% success rate since April, prompting expansion across U.S., European, and Asian fabs plus early-2027 Atlas humanoid trials.

galbot-s1-motion-belgium-warehouse.title: Galbot S1 & Gemini-Powered MotionOS Deploy to Belgian Warehouse Under €100k–150k Rental Model
galbot-s1-motion-belgium-warehouse.summary: Showcased at Slush 2026 by Motion Robotics, the 320 kg Galbot S1 (50 kg payload) paired with Google Cloud and Gemini-based MotionOS is shipping to a Belgian warehouse for automated palletizing under a €100k–150k European rental model.

digit-gxo-flowery-branch.title: Agility Digit Moves 100,000+ Totes in Live GXO Warehouse RaaS Deployment
digit-gxo-flowery-branch.summary: Under the industry's first multi-year RaaS humanoid contract (2024), GXO deployed Agility Digit at its Flowery Branch, Georgia warehouse, moving over 100,000 totes onto conveyors and expanding in Oct 2026 to new U.S. sites in 2027.

hmnd01-siemens-erlangen.title: Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha Completes Two-Week PoC at Siemens Erlangen Electronics Plant
hmnd01-siemens-erlangen.summary: Humanoid's wheeled HMND 01 Alpha ran a two-week proof of concept at Siemens' electronics plant in Erlangen, moving totes onto conveyors at 60 moves/hour with >8 hours uptime and >90% pick-and-place success.

anymal-equinor-vigier.title: ANYmal Surpasses 200+ Active Industrial Inspection Sites Across Equinor & Vigier Cement
anymal-equinor-vigier.summary: ANYbotics' Shift platform connects 200+ active quadruped deployments: Vigier Cement logged 33,000+ automated inspections saving $660,000 in maintenance costs, while ANYmal D deployed at Equinor's Northern Lights CO2 facility in March 2026.

galbot-g1-pharmacy-retail.title: Galbot G1 Operates 24/7 Smart Pharmacies (400–500 Orders/Day) & Scenic Retail Stores
galbot-g1-pharmacy-retail.summary: Galbot's G1 wheeled humanoid runs live autonomous pharmacy fulfillment at LBX Pharmacy in Shanghai (400–500 orders/day), Nepstar Beijing, and tourist sites including the Summer Palace, backed by 1,079 deliveries in 2025 and RMB 1.4B+ in orders.

apollo-mercedes-berlin.title: Apptronik Apollo Pilots at Mercedes-Benz Berlin & Hungary with Gemini Robotics 2.5
apollo-mercedes-berlin.summary: Mercedes-Benz has piloted Apptronik Apollo for assembly kit delivery and part inspection in Berlin-Marienfelde and Kecskemét since 2024, adding a multi-million-euro investment in 2025 alongside Omniverse digital twins and Gemini Robotics 2.5.

aeon-bmw-leipzig-schaeffler.title: Hexagon AEON Launches Europe's First Factory Humanoid Pilot at BMW Leipzig & Schaeffler
aeon-bmw-leipzig-schaeffler.summary: BMW Group began testing Hexagon's wheel-footed AEON at Plant Leipzig in Dec 2025 for high-voltage battery assembly and component manufacturing, followed by a 1,000-unit global factory deployment partnership with Schaeffler in April 2026.

figure02-bmw-spartanburg.title: Figure 02 Logs 1,250+ Hours & 90,000+ Parts in 11-Month BMW Spartanburg Deployment
figure02-bmw-spartanburg.summary: Across an 11-month body-shop deployment at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg, Figure 02 operated 10-hour Monday–Friday shifts, accumulating 1,250+ runtime hours, loading 90,000+ sheet-metal parts, and supporting 30,000+ BMW X3 vehicles.

walkers1-zeekr-nio-byd.title: UBTECH Walker S1/S2 Conducts World's First Multi-Humanoid Factory Training at Zeekr & BYD
walkers1-zeekr-nio-byd.summary: UBTECH deployed dozens of Walker S1 humanoids at Zeekr's 5G smart factory in Ningbo for multi-robot collaborative heavy box lifting and soft-material sorting, expanding with autonomous-battery-swapping Walker S2 units at BYD, NIO, and Foxconn.
metrics: Dozens of units in team training

digit-amazon-seattle.title: Agility Digit Achieves 98% Success in Empty-Tote Handling PoC at Amazon Seattle
digit-amazon-seattle.summary: During a fulfillment-center PoC in Seattle, Amazon tested Agility Robotics' Digit moving empty totes from processing stations to staging areas, reaching a 98% task success rate at an estimated $10–12/hour RaaS operating cost.

x30-sp-group-state-grid.title: DEEP Robotics X30 Deploys in Singapore SP Group Power Tunnels & 26 Chinese Provinces
x30-sp-group-state-grid.summary: DEEP Robotics' IP67 industrial quadruped X30 became the first Chinese quadruped deployed in an overseas power grid at Singapore SP Group's power tunnels, while operating across substations in 26 Chinese provinces.
